integrity: The complete 60-facet presentation reconstructs the complex. Integral Smith reduction gives H_1=Z; a primitive integer cocycle evaluates to +/-1 on all 76 nonfacial triangles. Exhaustive vertex-permutation checking gives 96 simplicial automorphisms, three systolic-carrier orbits of sizes 12,48,16, and both homology signs.
scientific_limitations: Applies to simple simplicial edge cycles in the specified labelled twelve-vertex twisted S3-bundle triangulation, not to geometric metric systoles or all triangulations. The +1/-1 orientation split depends on vertex ordering. The 2004 preprint date is attested only to year resolution; the earliest inspected day-resolved release is 2005-06-24.
title: All seventy-six empty triangles are primitive systoles in the twelve-vertex twisted \(S^3\)-bundle
